plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: none of its own: a package released as git tags; OpenVibe.Network serves /shared/* from its pinned tag, and a site can serve its own pinned copy (openvibe-shared/serve)
contracts: openvibe-contracts v0.399.0 (devDependency: the release manifest contract)
features: one move engine for a floating thing: OVFloat.attach gives the PiP's drag, flick, tuck and kept place to any box, and a panel window adopts it (4.208.0)
the one step view reads AG-UI (phases, titled steps, sources, thinking, compact groups, card mode) with the one composer to talk to a run, and crawlable first HTML for every site (4.205.0)
buttons that show their state (kinds, badge, dot, attention, busy/done/error, hold), resizable panel windows, the one composer everywhere, players that start sooner, and openvibe-shared/csp (4.204.0)
the Dock updates edited DM text and link cards live and lets authors edit their own messages (4.203.0)
the shared field dropdown, one dialog/sheet/panel window, user cards, eight site groups, measured page ends and remade reveal (4.202.0)
the page-view beacon sends ?in=1 only for a signed-in browser and counts a guest at once, so a signed-in person is counted from presence and never also as a guest (4.191.0)

the mark at work is the O as eight dots with three bright ones going round, and it has a state of its own for an agent that is thinking or writing (data-state=think); a phone's Dock opens and closes exactly as the menu does and wears its close button in its place; a button, field, select or text box that nobody styled wears the theme instead of the browser's grey (4.186.0)

the menu's You tab: your home right under your name (a 52px bar, was 68) and the AI card; Most used is the apps themselves under their bar, each a link and a full touch target; Jump back in last, saying what it is. A phone's Dock opens out of the navbar's menu button: its close orb starts on that orb and settles into its x while the navbar's orb makes the same move underneath, and closing runs it back (4.185.0)

motion has four choices (Automatic, Full, Calm, Off) and one signal, html[data-ov-motion]: Calm keeps every effect and makes it smaller and slower (--ov-move, display.move(), endless loops at 0.6 of their speed), and only Off stops motion; no rule in the package stops an effect because the device asked for less (4.183.0)

every shape glyph has a solid drawing (203 of 278; the other 75 are line glyphs that thicken when small), glyphs.svg() draws a solid's line parts as lines, and every product id has its own site mark, so no product draws the bare V (4.183.0)

the Dock's agent view, timeline and Actor ask Network's /api/frame relay instead of openvibe.codes and openvibe.actor, so a signed-in page logs no cross-origin console errors; an explicit base still reaches the product (4.181.0)

an agent's live panel: ov-canvas.js draws actor.canvas@1 (headings, text, lists, checklists, tables, metrics, bar and line charts, pictures from openvibe.media, https links, buttons) the same on every site; built node by node, a button only asks, a tick tells, versions only grow (4.145.0)

send it on OpenVibe: the share sheet's first place for a signed-in person is OpenVibe Chat; the Dock opens on Send to… (a conversation, or someone new by their name) and the message waits in the box until the person sends it, OpenVibeDock.share({ text, title }) (4.144.0)

one timeline for many players: ov-sync.js, OVSync.attach(mediaEl, { room, socket }), follows Chat's common.sync-clock@1 state over the room socket, measures the server clock with five time samples and holds the element within ±80 ms, nudging 0.95–1.05 or seeking, and respecting the control lease (4.143.0)
the menu on a phone has a round close button at the end of the search pill: it covers the whole screen, burger too (4.142.0)
the forms kit loads when a form control is drawn, not merely present: a closed dialog's select costs nothing (4.141.0)
the Compose export maps Material 3's container roles (cards, the navigation bar and its selected pill, dialogs) to Vibe surfaces, so native apps never show Material's lavender (4.140.0)
the menu's feed rows with a picture show the picture, not a site icon beside it; a row without one in that group keeps its icon in a picture-sized tile (4.139.0)
the footer's shipped line and brand logos load when the footer nears the screen (38 KB off most first visits); the footer, Boost and the glyphs load their files by content hash (4.138.0)

every script the bar, the Dock and the notifications load goes by its content hash (?v=), so a release reaches every open page at once instead of up to a day later; one menu button on a phone (4.137.0)

the Dock's Agent panel reads the timeline again (the token is resolved when a call is made), and the Dock can open at a step: OpenVibeNavbar.openDock('agent', { task }) marks it and brings it into view (4.134.0)
the OpenVibe Frame: navbar, footer, panels, account switcher, notification UI with realtime
the launcher beside the brand lists every site of the network, in groups; Ask Actor and the Vibes chip in the account menu
themes, design tokens, icons and ring icons
release manifest, in-place updates in open tabs and update metrics
web runtime (feature loader)
page shell: openvibe-shared/shell page(), the shared page shell every web product renders through, with an installable web-app manifest and icons per site
showcase sections for product home pages (openvibe-shared/showcase)
share cards for every site and for its big pages (openvibe-shared/social)
the shared video player (player.js, player.css): one look for every <video>
the player's AD control: a descriptions track is remembered per person, toggled with D and spoken through speech synthesis (4.126.0)
Ask your agent: kit.askAgent and any [data-ov-ask] control open your Vibe in the Dock with the question waiting, unsent; and every page preconnects to openvibe.network (4.134.0)
a picture on the menu's network cards: each entry's 64×36 thumbnail before its title when the site sent one (frame.menu-card@1 images, Contracts 0.320.0), https only and lazy (4.133.0)
your feeds in the menu: choose which sites' cards show (Today, News, Trending, New worlds…) and their order; and the navbar keeps the Frame's cards, next and beacon, which it used to drop (4.132.0)
your online status on every site: a dot on your picture, a heartbeat once a minute across tabs, and a picker (Online, Do not disturb, Invisible, a status line) in the account menu (4.131.0)
your things on every site: Messages (opens your DMs in place, in the Dock) with Chat's unread count, and the OpenCoins and Vibes balances, on unless a site says no (4.130.0)
one menu: the burger opens the OpenVibe menu, this site's pages first and Display at its foot; the old drawer only for sites that ask (4.129.0)

the menu rethought around real use: who is live, your places dock, this site's pages, next from here, two places new to you, you and your agents, tools, every site behind a count, jump back in; a click beacon when Network asks (4.128.0)
items.js: what people wear from OpenVibe.Inventory (name effects, hats, particles, community badges), drawn the same on every site
shipped pill, recent list and /updates log
server helpers: ready, metrics, trace, egress, config, analytics, legal, SEO (sitemaps with video entries, IndexNow in requests of 100 URLs), frame SSR
browser harness and perf budgets for tests
a CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED notification type: an agent owner is told when a sensitive-capability confirmation awaits them
the Dock pops out into a window of its own (Document Picture-in-Picture): the same panel, the same tabs, the page's pill saying where the Dock went
the Dock accepts a refreshing token (string, sync or async) and an optional read-only scope set: the extension hides approve/decline and the chat composer while keeping reads

vibes-pay.js: OpenVibe.vibes.pay(payUrl) opens the Vibes Pay sheet (popup on a computer, full page on a phone), resolves { status } from an origin-checked postMessage and binds <button data-ov-vibes-pay> in the Vibes accent, both themes (D12)
openvibe-shared/config accepts x-unit seconds for an integer owner setting, so an owner form can label the input in seconds
a navbar link can be the site's one featured piece (featured: true): a quiet accent pill with its glyph, first in the phone's menu (4.117.0)
